column1: # Optional enrichment for the standards lists that scripts/generate-standards-lists.sh
# renders into agent configs. The standards/ tree is the manifest: a file appears in
# every generated list whether or not it has a row here. A row only supplies a better
# description than the document's H1 title and, for language standards, the file
# `make check-agent-configs` fails when a row points at a file that does not exist.

column2: Core architecture, SOLID principles, naming conventions
Containerized agent-dev environment (sandboxed Docker dev image, egress allow-list, secret injection, YOLO permissions)
Agent tools and MCP servers (schemas, write gating, untrusted-data fencing)
Swift (SwiftPM, Swift 6 strict concurrency, swift-format, XCTest/Swift Testing)
TypeScript (pnpm, prettier, eslint, vitest, strict mode)
Rust (cargo, rustfmt, clippy -D warnings in CI, cargo-deny, Result<T, E>)
Zig (zig build, zig fmt, manual memory management)
Go (go modules, gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint, table-driven tests)
C++ (C++20 baseline, CMake presets, clang-format/clang-tidy, warnings-as-errors in CI, sanitizer lanes, C ABI ownership rules)
ADR (bullet metadata), spec/plan/design-pass/verification docs, changelog, user docs
Test governance: quarantine registry, flake report, fast/slow tiers, routing table, scoped coverage, gates, PR evidence
Security guidelines with P0-P2 severity model
Canonical cross-cutting standards (Clean Architecture, SOLID, naming, testing coverage targets) referenced by all agent configs
